description: Generates one new UI component from a text description with the AnimatedWebs AI generator and returns a complete, self-contained HTML document (Tailwind CDN, inline JS) as plain text, preceded by an HTML comment naming the model and the generations left today. Use this when no library component fits; use search (kind components) first to reuse an existing one and refine_component to change a result. Each successful call uses one of the account's daily generations (Free 5, Pro 100 per UTC day, shared with refine_component and the tools site); a call where no model ran is not counted. Requires sign-in, is not idempotent (each call yields different output), and can answer that the generator is busy, in which case retry after a minute.

prompt.description: What to build, 8 to 1200 characters. Name the content, layout and motion. Example: 'a pricing section with three plans and a yearly toggle'.

style.description: Visual system: luxury (dark, gold accent, serif), editorial (warm light page, oxblood accent), glass (navy-black, frosted layers, violet accent) or brutalist (black and white, signal red, hard borders). Default luxury.

name: generate_component
title: Generate UI component
